remote_enabled.description: Enable remote firmware metadata (from fwupd.org). Disable for offline or air-gapped systems.

metadata_path.description: Override default firmware metadata directory. Leave blank to use system default.

firmware_dir.description: Override default firmware blob storage directory. Leave blank to use system default.

auto_download.description: Automatically download firmware updates: true → always, false → manual, null → report only (no download).

auto_install.description: Automatically install firmware updates: true → always, false → manual, null → report only (no install).

min_battery.description: Minimum battery percentage required before applying firmware updates. Prevents updates on low power.

download_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for firmware downloads before aborting.

allowed_remotes.description: List of allowed remote firmware metadata URLs. Only these will be trusted if strict verification is enabled.

test_firmware.description: Allow installation of test firmware. Only enable for development or testing — test firmware may be unstable.

firmware_lock.description: Enable firmware lock (requires user confirmation before flashing). Recommended for production systems.

ignore_versions.description: List of firmware versions to skip during updates (e.g., to avoid known-bad revisions).

conf_dir.description: Directory containing additional configuration fragments (.conf files).

offline_updates.description: Enable updates without network access (uses only local firmware blobs).

ui_hints.description: Enable desktop/UI notifications (e.g., popups about pending updates).

disabled_device_types.description: List of device types to exclude from updates (e.g., 'device:usb', 'device:pcie', 'device:tpm').

items.description: A device type identifier in the format 'device:subsystem' (e.g., 'device:usb')

enabled_device_types.description: List of device types to include for updates (whitelist). If non-empty, only these devices are updated.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging. Helps troubleshooting, but may expose sensitive info.

ca_bundle.description: Path to a custom CA certificate bundle for verifying TLS connections.

verification.description: Enable signature verification for firmware metadata and blobs. Critical for security.

vendor_metadata_path.description: Override default vendor metadata directory (e.g., for OEM-specific firmware).

local_cache.description: Store downloaded firmware locally for reuse and offline updates.

max_concurrent_downloads.description: Maximum number of firmware downloads allowed in parallel.

checksum_verification.description: Verify firmware checksums before installation. Strongly recommended.
